title: DeepSeek raises API pricing for its V4 models
excerpt: Chinese artificial intelligence ​startup DeepSeek will ‌raise API prices for its ​V4-Pro and ​V4-Flash models and introduce ⁠peak and ​off-peak pricing, a ​company statement on Thursday showed.
content_html:
By Reuters

August 13, 202611:56 AM UTCUpdated ago

BEIJING, Aug 13 (Reuters) - Chinese artificial intelligence ​startup DeepSeek will ‌raise API prices for its ​V4-Pro and ​V4-Flash models and introduce ⁠peak and ​off-peak pricing, a ​company statement on Thursday showed.

The new rates - ​ranging from ​50% to 1,100% above ‌current ⁠prices, depending on the model, token type, ​and ​time ⁠of use - will take ​effect on ​August ⁠17, according to the statement.

content_html_zh:
路透社

八月 13, 202611:56 AM UTC 更新前

路透北京 8 月 13 日 - 中国人工智能初创公司 DeepSeek 周四发布的一份公司声明显示，该公司将提高其 V4-Pro 和 V4-Flash 型号的 API 价格，并引入高峰和非高峰定价。

根据声明，新费率 - 比当前价格高 50% 至 1,100%，具体取决于型号、代币类型和使用时间 - 将于 8 月 17 日生效。

在这里注册。

​陈秀豪​和 Ryan Woo 报道；埃米莉亚·西托尔-马塔里斯编辑
